hab: Ponds, fountains and anywhere with an audience
Deep water under bright studio lights
bio: A goldfish that flops up to anyone who will watch and pitches them an idea. Nobody has ever said yes, and it has never once stopped talking.
One day the pitching goldfish stopped asking and started deciding. It circles the pond, hears every idea, and says one thing before it bites: "I'm out."
note: Has an idea for you. And another one.
